title: Equivariant germs on a nonempty one-point etale scheme are a section
statement: Let $K,K_s,\Omega$ be fields in $\mathrm{Type}\,u$, with compatible embeddings $K\to K_s\to\Omega$, where $K_s$ is a separable closure of $K$ [def-pd-separable-closure] and $\Omega$ is algebraically closed. Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}K$, $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K_s/K)$, and $w=\max(u+1,v)$. Let $F$ be a sheaf with values in $\mathrm{Type}\,w$ on the small etale site of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and let $p$ be the geometric point defined by $K\to\Omega$, with stalk $p^*F$ and germ maps $\gamma_{Y,y}:F(Y)\to p^*F$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Suppose $\rho:G\to(p^*F\to p^*F)$ satisfies $\rho(g)(\gamma_{Y,y}(z))=\gamma_{Y,y^{\prime}}(z)$ whenever $\tau:\Omega\simeq_K\Omega$ extends $g$ and $y^{\prime}=\operatorname{Spec}(\tau)\circ y$. No action laws for $\rho$ need be assumed separately. For any nonempty etale $K$-scheme $X$ whose underlying space has exactly one point and function $f:p(X)\to p^*F$ satisfying $f(x^{\prime})=\rho(g)(f(x))$ whenever $\tau$ extends $g$ and $x^{\prime}=\operatorname{Spec}(\tau)\circ x$, there exists $z\in F(X)$ such that $\gamma_{X,x}(z)=f(x)$ for every lift $x\in p(X)$. No assertion for empty schemes or for schemes with more than one point is made.

proof.text: Construct a nonempty geometric lift of X with Mathlib exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed, using the fact that Spec K is subsingleton. Choose x₀ from this nonempty fibre. No etale_fibre_discrete_separable_points application is used.
Apply the selected-lift reconstruction obligation to obtain a section z whose germ at x₀ is f x₀.
Apply propagation from the selected lift to identify the germ of z with f at every lift.

lean.statement:
theorem field_equivariant_germ_family_section_onePoint
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) v)))
    (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) [Subsingleton X.left] [Nonempty X.left] :
    let p := pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))
    ∀ (ρ : Gal(Ks/K) → p.sheafFiber.obj F → p.sheafFiber.obj F),
      (∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
        (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
          τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
        (Y : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) (y y' : p.fiber.obj Y)
        (hy : y'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ y.left)
        (z : F.obj.obj (op Y)),
        ρ g (p.toPresheafFiber Y y F.obj z) = p.toPresheafFiber Y y' F.obj z) →
      ∀ (f : p.fiber.obj X → p.sheafFiber.obj F),
        (∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
          (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
            τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
          (x x' : p.fiber.obj X)
          (hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left),
          f x' = ρ g (f x)) →
        ∃ z : F.obj.obj (op X), ∀ x : p.fiber.obj X,
          p.toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z = f x
